item.title: someone popped my cloudflare and used a worker to inject malware on a site under my domain for 22 hours
item.description: a friend's mini-app, hosted on a subdomain of mine. a user reported a fake captcha telling them to paste a rundll32 command. the source repo was clean. the origin was clean. the cloudflare-proxied response wasn't.
